profile.headline: Senior Angular/React Developer at Huntington National Bank
profile.summary: Front End Angular/React Developer with a demonstrated history of quick learning, flexibility, and problem solving.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
2025:
Rewrote one of our oldest Angular applications into React.

Collaborated with other technical leads to create a React standards document to ensure quality of code, readability, and maintainability within our applications.

Actively collaborates with product managers and UI/UX designers at a feature level to deliver seamless, user-centric, and high-quality front-end solutions.

2024:
Worked on the initial development of a "One-Click" feature which allows customers to open certain accounts via a single button click. The project was then expanded to my team to complete in record time. 

Part of the initiative to create coding standards when switching from Angular to React development.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.insights: HTML5, Agile Software Development and +3 skills

positions.title: Viacom
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
Quickly learned and utilized new technologies (Angular, NgRx, Angular Material, RxJs) to create a new form-driven internal application. 
Designed and developed a reusable dynamic form builder that would dynamically generate a form based upon a configuration file. 
Practiced and facilitated scrum ceremonies to follow Agile software development. 
Worked with an over-seas team to develop the application before independently taking over the project. 
Implemented and practiced test-driven development and code reviews to ensure the highest quality of code.

positions.title: American Modern Insurance Group (AMIG)
positions.description:
Utilized Java, Spring MVC, SQL, and Squirrel DB to maintain and upgrade the backend of an existing, internal timemanagement project. 
Utilized Bootstrap, jQuery, JavaScript, JSPs, HTML, and CSS to upgrade the UI of the time-management system. 
Followed best code practices to optimize and refactor UI code for better readability, reusability, and maintainability.
Independently managed VSTS to database projects.

positions.title: Customer Service Representative
positions.description:
Developed teamwork skills while providing quick customer service. 
Used time management to get daily tasks done efficiently.

positions.title: Customer Service Representative
positions.description:
Implemented teamwork to provide customer service under fast-paced conditions.
Interacted with customers to provide information in response to inquiries about products and services and to handle and resolve complaints.
